name: Shion
source:
Katsurou's senior as a host. A year has passed since his "[url=https://vndb.org/v37168]Princess Cage[/url]" days, and he now holds the position of acting representative. He admires famous hosts, and so tries to imitate their hairstyles. His hobby recently has been muscle training.

[Translated from the [url=https://enoshima210.work/2023/05/24/sini/]official website[/url]]
